UserRbacProfile.title: UserRbacProfile
UserRbacProfile.description: Stores the user identity, RBAC role (SUPER_ADMIN, GESTIONNAIRE, TECHNICIEN), hardware device fingerprint binding, and security shield status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

rbacRole.description: RBAC role restricting DMS and sensitive data access.

boundHardwareDeviceId.description: Android Keystore Hardware-Backed Device Fingerprint ID.

operatorPinHash.description: Hashed 4-digit operator PIN for workshop kiosk lock.

isRemoteWiped.description: True if offline AES-256-GCM cache was remotely wiped.

UserAccountSelection.title: UserAccountSelection
UserAccountSelection.description: Stores the user's selected AccountRole (CONDUCTEUR, GARAGE_PRO, VENDEUR_PIECES, ATELIER_MAGASIN_MIXTE, ATELIER_CARROSSERIE, LOCATION_VOITURES) chosen in AccountSelector on first login, including hybrid sub-accounts and external MecaVerif+ rate.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Primary account holder or company manager name.

accountRole.description: Selected account role that dynamically filters all application menus and screens.

organizationName.description: Name of the workshop, parts store, hybrid shop, bodyshop, or enterprise.

wilaya.description: Wilaya of the user or business.

subAccountsCount.description: Number of configured sub-accounts (e.g. 3 or 4 for ATELIER_MAGASIN_MIXTE).

subAccountsSummary.description: Summary of the primary account and configured sub-accounts.

subscriptionPriceDzd.description: Annual subscription price in DZD for the chosen account role.

mecaVerifFeePerVinDzd.description: External per-VIN fee in DZD for MecaVerif+ (250 or 300 DA, not included in subscriptions).

SecurityAuditEvent.title: SecurityAuditEvent
SecurityAuditEvent.description: Tamper-proof audit log entry with HMAC-SHA256 signature for RBAC actions, hardware binding, anti-scraping, and DMS operations.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator.

rbacRole.description: Role of the operator at the time of the action.

shieldCategory.description: Security shield module (HARDWARE_BINDING, ANTI_SCRAPING, HMAC_SIGNATURE, AES256_VAULT, PLAY_INTEGRITY, RBAC_AUDIT).

actionDescription.description: Detailed description of the security or DMS operation.

hmacSha256Seal.description: Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 seal verifying document/event integrity.

VendorStockItem.title: VendorStockItem
VendorStockItem.description: Real-time vendor part stock item for Espace Vendeur.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vendor.

SystemErrorLog.title: SystemErrorLog
SystemErrorLog.description: Centralized error log entry capturing runtime crashes, API connection failures, and local persistence/Firebase sync failures for SuperAdmin monitoring.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user/session where the error occurred.

userEmail.description: Email of the authenticated user or operator.

rbacRole.description: RBAC role of the operator when the error occurred.

errorCategory.description: Category of the captured error or client bug report.

moduleSource.description: Subsystem or module that raised the error.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code or exception type.

errorTitle.description: Concise summary title of the error.

stackTracePreview.description: Stack trace snippet or structured diagnostic payload.

deviceHardwareInfo.description: Hardware fingerprint, Android version, and Wilaya.

resolutionStatus.description: Current AI self-healing or SuperAdmin resolution status.

superAdminNote.description: AI Auto-Repair patch summary or diagnostic note added by SuperAdmin.

/users/{userId}.description: User RBAC profile and hardware device binding.

/user_account_selections/{userId}.description: User account role chosen via AccountSelector on first login to dynamically filter the UI.

/security_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Tamper-proof RBAC and Mekanik+ Shield security audit events.

/vendor_stock/{stockId}.description: Real-time inventory management items for Espace Vendeur.

/system_error_logs/{errorId}.description: Error Logger records for runtime crashes, API connection issues, and local/Firebase persistence failures.
